Class Allay

java.lang.Object
entities.Entity
entities.Allay
Direct Known Subclasses:
Archer, Knight
public abstract class Allay extends Entity
Represents an Allay entity, which is a friendly or allied entity that can assist the player.

Allays extend the Entity class and include behaviors for chasing and attacking enemies, either through close-range combat or ranged shooting. They are restricted from walking off-screen.

      protected void chaseAsShooter(EnemyManager em)
      Specialized chasing behavior for ranged-capable Allays. Manages distance to the closest enemy, switching between movement, close-range attacking, and ranged shooting.
